components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main action in a panel or editor: Save, Upload tasks.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Upload tasks and get a PIN</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2B3FD0; color: #fff; font: 650 0.9375rem/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2233B4; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #11162F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Capture field
components.description: The title field and round Add in the ink header.
components.css: .ds-head { padding: 1rem; background: #2B3FD0; border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px; } .ds-capture { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 .375rem 0 .875rem; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(6,10,40,.6); } .ds-capture span { color: #2B3FD0; font-size: 1.375rem; } .ds-capture input { flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 500 1.125rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #11162F; } .ds-capture input::placeholder { color: #6A7192; } .ds-capture button { width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2B3FD0; color: #fff; font-size: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Status switch
components.description: All, Open, and Done with counts; the selection slides.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 4px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,22,47,.05), 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(17,22,47,.16); } .ds-seg button { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #4B5378; font: 600 .9375rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-seg [aria-checked=true] { background: #2B3FD0; color: #fff; }

components.name: Filter chip

components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 .875rem; border: 1px solid #C3CAE2; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #11162F; font: 600 .875rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-chip--tag[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: #2B3FD0; background: #2B3FD0; color: #fff; }

components.css: .ds-group { border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,22,47,.05), 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(17,22,47,.16); overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; gap: .875rem; padding: .875rem 1rem; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid #DDE2F0; } .ds-ring { flex: none; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border: 2px solid #B42330; border-radius: 999px; background: #FBE9EA; } .ds-title { font: 550 1.0625rem/1.3 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #11162F; } .ds-note { font: .9375rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: #4B5378; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; margin-top: .3rem; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 .5rem; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #FBE9EA; color: #B42330; font: 650 .8125rem system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-done .ds-ring { border-color: #2B3FD0; background: #2B3FD0; } .ds-done .ds-title { color: #4B5378; } .ds-done .ds-title span { background: linear-gradient(#2B3FD0,#2B3FD0) 0 58%/100% 2px no-repeat; }

narrative.overview: Task Cloud is a list you write in ballpoint ink. The ink header holds the capture field, so writing a task is the first thing every screen offers, and completing a task draws an ink stroke through it. The old teal-and-stone bookish column and the slim solid app bar are the anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: The ink header owns the top of each tab and holds the capture field on the list.
Tasks sit in white inset groups on a pale ink ground.
Priority is a flag plus a word in red, amber, or green; the ring takes the hue.
The ink cross-off is the signature move.
Bricolage Grotesque for the words; the platform sans for controls.

rules.name: The Separate Priority Rule
rules.body: Ink means an action, the current view, or finished work. Red, amber, and green mean urgency, always with the word.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Capturing a task is one field and one round Add; details open only once a draft exists.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper on the ground takes the raise shadow and no border; fields inside paper take a sunken fill and an ink ring on focus.

dos: Do keep capture to one field and one Add button at the top of the list.
Do write priority as High, Medium, or Low next to its hue.
Do put destructive actions in settings as sentences that say what is deleted and where.
Do keep English and Spanish on the translation keys.
donts: Don't bring back a centred dialog for creating or editing a task.
Don't show priority by colour alone, or use the ink as a priority colour.
Don't add eyebrow labels, decorative icon tiles, or gradients.
Don't confirm single-task deletes; offer Undo.
